theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratio is the annual cost charged by fund managers to operate the fund. It's expressed as a percentage of your investment.
caption: Every fund incurs costs for management, administration, and operations. A lower expense ratio means more of your money works for growth. Active funds typically have higher ratios due to frequent trading, while passive funds track indices with minimal intervention. #MutualFundLiteracy #ExpenseRatio #InvestmentBasics #FundEducation #SmartInvesting
